speeches.script: Born into a theatrical household in London, Benedict Cumberbatch seemed destined for the stage. Harrow. Manchester. RADA. Every step, a preparation for something extraordinary.
The early years were a masterclass in patience. Stage productions, BBC bit parts — each one a brushstroke in a portrait still waiting to be revealed.
Hollywood called in every register. Turing. Khan. Smaug. Strange. He didn't just play icons. He became them.
Today, Benedict Cumberbatch is something rarer than a star — he is a standard. CBE. BAFTA winner. Hamlet at the Barbican, sold out in minutes. Relentlessly, brilliantly human.
From London fog to Strange dimensions — and back to the stage where it began. History, one life at a time.
